name: Raptor Mastery
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary sends you after the raptor that has eluded even him. After your trials against lesser beasts, you are to track Tethis and bring its talon back to Hemet.

sections.title: The Wily Predator of the Vale
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary tells you of Tethis, a vicious raptor that has escaped every hunter, even the expedition leader. Ajeck Rouack gave the beast its name. Among Stranglethorn's raptors, Tethis is the greatest challenge for a hunter.

sections.title: Claiming the Talon
sections.body: Tethis roams north of the Gurubashi Arena. Bring Hemet a talon from the slain raptor, and he will recognize you as a master raptor slayer. No other big game hunter has achieved that feat.

faq.q: Who sends you to hunt Tethis?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary sends you to hunt Tethis from his expedition encampment in northern Stranglethorn Vale, after you prove your tracking skill against ordinary jungle raptors.
Tethis prowls the jungle around the Gurubashi Arena, most often in the brush north of the colosseum.

faq.q: What proof does Hemet require of the kill?
faq.answer: Hemet requires Tethis's talon as proof that you have brought the raptor down.

faq.q: Who originally named the raptor Tethis?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack, one of the hunters at Nesingwary's expedition camp, gave the raptor the name Tethis.
